Type: rug
Name: Ravenna Home Vintage Rug, 6' x 9', Pink on Ivory
Colors: Ivory/Pink
6'W x 9'L 100% polypropylene; backing: 100% latex This gorgeous rug is power loomed with striated pink patterns on an ivory-white field, bringing an elegance to your favorite room. The medium 0.5" pile suits any indoor space. Pair with rug pad (sold separately)
